finding: Source inspection shows that build_qubo_projection validates each QuboVariable.source_ref against the selected WorldSlice and its tainted_atom_ids, but the public QuboProjection dataclass constructor itself has no WorldSlice object or admission token and therefore cannot enforce those same slice-membership and taint invariants. score_assignment accepts any QuboProjection instance whose self-derived sha256 matches expected_projection_sha256. Consequently a caller can construct a syntactically valid QuboProjection directly with arbitrary valid slice identity fields and a variable whose source_ref was never admitted from that slice, hash that forged projection, and present the matching self-hash to score_assignment. This is a source-level candidate counterexample to fail-closed exact slice binding at the public object/scoring boundary. It is not yet executable falsification evidence.
counterhypothesis: The intended ABI may define build_qubo_projection as the sole admissible constructor and treat direct QuboProjection instantiation as non-admissible raw data. If so, that restriction is not enforced by the currently observed public dataclass/scoring boundary. The counterexample is closed only if admissibility is made mechanically unforgeable or score_assignment independently verifies a trusted binding to the actual WorldSlice/admission evidence.

proposed_exact_source_falsifier.forgery: Directly instantiate QuboProjection using that real slice_id and slice_sha256 but a QuboVariable(source_ref='atom:not-selected', ...) while keeping all constructor-local structural constraints valid.
proposed_exact_source_falsifier.current_source_predicted_result: Construction and scoring succeed because neither QuboProjection.__post_init__ nor score_assignment can reconstruct selected/tainted membership from the claimed slice digest alone.
proposed_exact_source_falsifier.safe_expected_result: Fail closed before a score is admitted unless the projection carries unforgeable evidence that its variables were validated against the exact bound WorldSlice.

existing_suite_gap: The observed 8-test suite checks out-of-slice and tainted source_ref rejection through build_qubo_projection, but does not exercise direct QuboProjection construction followed by score_assignment.
recommended_smallest_repair: Add the direct-constructor forged-slice-binding case to the canonical adversarial suite before retaining generation-1 acceptance against this falsifier.

Prefer one mechanically enforced admission boundary: either make raw QuboProjection construction non-admissible/private and require a non-forgeable validated-construction marker, or make score_assignment require/revalidate the exact WorldSlice (or an independently trusted admission receipt) instead of trusting projection self-hash alone.
Do not use a marker that callers can freely supply as another dataclass field; that would move rather than close the forgery boundary.
Preserve existing exact slice digest/generation, taint, canonical-order and authority-none checks.
